rules.statement: Always reuse the registered Button component for any clickable action; never hand-roll a new button element.
rules.rationale: Button already encodes accessibility, focus, and state handling.

rules.statement: Do not create a second 'card-like' canonical component; extend Card's variants instead.
Use spacing tokens (spacing-4, spacing-16, ...) for layout gaps; never hardcode pixel values for spacing.
Use the empty-state pattern whenever a list or collection view has zero items.
Every Modal instance must set aria-labelledby to the modal's title element id.
